verdict.rationale: Mintlify's Automations feature explicitly supports running the documentation agent autonomously on a schedule, on repo pushes, or on connected integration events, with pre-built automations requiring no manual setup — a clear background-agentic capability. This is corroborated by the agent docs (research/plan/write/PR) and blog updates describing redesigned automations for quicker setup. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of automation reliability and no detail on failure handling or monitoring of autonomous runs.
